title: Coordinate lists
description: The ready-made lists the Coordinate list field offers, and the regions its menu groups them under. Every name, description and region heading here is a user-facing string the maintainer approves before it lands.

regions.description: The menu's headings, in the order the menu shows them. A heading stands at the top or under the one its parent names, and a parent comes before the headings under it. A region with no list anywhere under it is not shown.

name.description: The heading as the menu reads it.

parent.description: The name of the heading this one opens under: a country's continent, a region's country. A heading with none stands at the top of the menu.

places.description: The places a region covers when its heading names none of them, so a search for one finds the region's lists. Never shown.

lists.description: One entry per list, in the order its region shows them.

id.description: A slug that never changes once shipped: a share link names a list by it.

name.description: The list as the menu reads it, in title case.

description.description: One or two sentences saying what the list is.

region.description: The name of one entry in `regions`.

file.description: The list's CSV beside this file: its id and `.csv`.

peaks.description: How many rows the CSV holds. The crawl writes it and a test recomputes it.

credit.description: Who chose the list's peaks: a club, an author, or the rule that picks them.

crawled.description: The day the rows were read from the source.
